$comment: Shape sidecar for comment-thread-vm.json (architect-57). Items are oldest first; kind comment | event | system. body is null for an event, a system line or a deleted comment; text (a LabelRef) only for event and system lines. Delivery statuses: pending | working | replied | failed | no-reply | unavailable. Event items also carry delivery. Retry POST /api/v[23]/projects/:id/comments/:cid/retry {agentId}: 202, original author, failed/no-reply only.
